names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 21 ianuarie, «Sfântul Mucenic Neofit».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 21 Ιανουαρίου, «Άγιος Νεόφυτος ο Μάρτυρας», with the rank words left off.

death.note: doxologia.ro's life gives no year for the martyrdom but dates the reign it fell in: «Într-acea vreme împărăţeau la Răsărit şi la Apus tiranii Dioclețian (284-305) și Maximian (286-305)». The day it gives is 21 January.

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (19 September 2026).

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 21 ianuarie — «Sfântul Mucenic Neofit»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 21ης Ιανουαρίου — «Άγιος Νεόφυτος ο Μάρτυρας»

attestations.note: Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (19 September 2026).

hymns.text: Mucenicul Tău, Doamne, Neofit, întru nevoinţa sa, cununa nestricăciunii a dobândit de la Tine, Dumnezeul nostru; că având puterea Ta, pe chinuitori a învins; zdrobit-a şi ale demonilor neputincioase îndrăzniri. Pentru rugăciunile lui, mântuieşte sufletele noastre, Hristoase Dumnezeule.

source.text: Doxologia — Troparul Sfântului Mucenic Neofit, Glasul 4

english.text: Thy martyr Neophytus, O Lord, in his contest received the crown of incorruption from thee our God; for having thy strength he cast down the tormentors, and broke also the feeble daring of the demons. At his prayers, O Christ God, save our souls.

hymns.tone: Ήχος πλ. α'. Τον συνάναρχον Λόγον.
hymns.text: Εκ σπάργανων επλήσθης της θείας χάριτος, ώσπερ νεόφυτοι έρνος χαριτωθείς την ψυχήν, και θαυμάτων αυτουργός ξένων γενόμενος, ηνδρανάθησας στερρώς, δι' αγώνων Ιερών, Νεόφυτε Αθλοφόρε. Αλλά μη παύση πρεσβεύων, ελεηθήναι τας ψυχάς ημών.

source.text: saint.gr — Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ήχος πλ. α', «Τον συνάναρχον Λόγον», on the page of Άγιος Νεόφυτος ο Μάρτυρας; monotonic as the page prints it

english.text: From thy swaddling clothes thou wast filled with divine grace, thy soul made graceful like a newly planted shoot; and having become a worker of strange wonders, thou didst bear thyself manfully and firmly through sacred struggles, O Neophytus, bearer of the prize. Cease not to intercede that our souls may find mercy.

hymns.text: Ὁ Μάρτυς σου Κύριε, ἐν τῇ ἀθλήσει αὐτοῦ, τὸ στέφος ἐκομίσατο τῆς ἀφθαρσίας, ἐκ σοῦ τοῦ Θεοῦ ἡμῶν· ἔχων γὰρ τὴν ἰσχύν σου, τοὺς τυράννους καθεῖλεν ἔθραυσε καὶ δαιμόνων τὰ ἀνίσχυρα θράση. Αὐτοῦ ταῖς ἱκεσίαις Χριστέ ὁ Θεός, σῶσον τὰς ψυχὰς ἡμῶν.

source.text: saint.gr — Έτερον Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ἦχος δ’, «Ταχύ προκατάλαβε», on the page of Άγιος Νεόφυτος ο Μάρτυρας; this is the common of a single martyr, printed there under his name

english.text: Thy martyr, O Lord, in his contest received the crown of incorruption from thee, our God; for having thy strength he cast down the tyrants and broke the powerless effrontery of demons. By his entreaties, O Christ God, save our souls.
